sections.title: Identification and form
sections.text: This entry represents Prunus persica, the peach. This spreading deciduous tree can reach about 6 m. It flowers in spring before the leaves emerge.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The lance-shaped leaves reach 15 cm. The pink to red flowers are about 4 cm across. The fruit is a rounded drupe, usually fuzzy and yellow to reddish; the nectarine is a smooth-skinned form of the same species.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: The flesh of the ripe fruit is eaten. The hard stone is not intended to be eaten.
